heading: Demonstration hydrogen production at existing nuclear power plants

tree.heading: Demonstration projects
tree.text: The Secretary shall provide for the establishment of 2 projects in geographic areas that are regionally and climatically diverse to demonstrate the commercial production of hydrogen at existing nuclear power plants.

tree.heading: Economic analysis
tree.text: Prior to making an award under subsection (a), the Secretary shall determine whether the use of existing nuclear power plants is a cost-effective means of producing hydrogen.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary for the purposes of carrying out this section not more than $100,000,000.
